surfaces.condition: The authored skill contract, scoped-compass or quiz helper, schema, tests, or provider metadata changes.
A root or subsystem compass, registry entry or link, declared path, continuity record, quiz result, or checkpoint is added, changed, removed, or brought across a fold.
validation: Confirm every active registry entry and declared path exists after the operation; retire removed scopes without deleting their history.
Confirm parent outcomes and cross-compass links are aligned or explicitly unknown, blocked, or drifted.

surfaces.condition: A distributed Project Compass file or capability changes.
The Project Compass distribution payload or destination changes.
The hosted source is promoted to the provider-neutral canonical skill root.
validation: Compare hosted and installed Project Compass directory snapshots and hashes.

surfaces.condition: Hosting, source identity, hashes, provider state, or parity evidence changes.
Triggers, required reads, verification, observable output, done criteria, approvals, precedence, host assumptions, or mandatory structure changes.
validation: TMCP static skill evaluation and behavioral trigger/output evaluation

surfaces.path: scripts/compass_projection.py, scripts/compass_change.py, references/development.schema.json, references/projections.schema.json, scripts/compass_bootstrap.py, scripts/test_compass_preservation.py
surfaces.condition: Family/change-context schema, accepted intent binding, proof freshness, or assessment disposition changes.
validation: Compare references/fixtures/family.json with the Pronto consumer fixture.
Dogfood changed skill in fresh contexts against bounded, draft and conflicting cases.
Verify explicit unknown behavior coverage, substantive bootstrap links, cumulative continuation, and semantic drift with green smoke tests.
Exercise v2 assessment: current reviewed simplification, protective retention, rejection, stale evidence, and observed benefit separately from preservation proof.

add: Register every new root or subsystem compass and its declared paths.
Validate parent outcomes and cross-compass links before accepting coverage.
change: Reconcile changed purpose, boundary, paths, parent outcomes, links, continuity, and quiz answers.
Run family validation and scoring after the changed truth is recorded.
remove: Retire removed scopes and preserve their history instead of deleting the record.
Remove or resolve dangling paths, parent outcomes, and cross-compass links.
fold: Compare source and target compass families before accepting the folded result.
Preserve source-only or conflicting truth as active, retired, or explicitly unresolved; never infer product progress from the fold alone.
Run family validation and scoring against the post-fold tree.

packet_serialization_review.change: Lossless compact JSON fallback preserves the 32 KiB packet limit and all intent fields.
packet_serialization_review.consumer_impact: Pronto parses JSON; schema and fields remain unchanged. Manifest file membership unchanged.
